entries.summary: Port 21 TuffUI components and fix EmojiReaction trigger

components.title: Accordion & Collapsible
components.description: Spring-height disclosure sections: a single or multiple accordion with icons and meta, and a standalone collapsible for reasoning.

components.title: Agent Composer
components.description: Chat input for AI agents with an Ask / Plan / Act switch, model chip, token-counted context tray, @ file and / command menus, and a message queue while the agent streams.

components.title: Blast Radius
components.description: Rings of hops around a leaked key or an agent, with the affected set traced back to the centre in red.

components.title: Choice Controls
components.description: A recessed switch with I / O glyphs, a checkbox with a mixed state and a radio group with roving arrow-key focus.

components.title: Context Window Meter
components.description: A cell grid showing how full a model context window is, split by source, with a warning zone and a Compact action.

components.title: Conversation List
components.description: A chat sidebar with date groups, search, inline rename, pin, and undoable archive or delete.

components.title: Deploy Timeline
components.description: Prompt and model versions on a rail over the eval score they shipped with, with regressions, rollbacks and a live canary line.

components.title: Eval Race
components.description: Models scoring the same eval set drawn as a race around a stadium track, with live standings, gaps and fastest lap.

components.title: Eval Results
components.description: A case grid for an eval run with outcome filters, a detail panel and a compare view of metrics and regressions.

components.title: Lap Timer
components.description: A pipeline run as a stopwatch: a sweeping hand, sector arcs coloured by split against best, and a live delta.

components.title: Match Field
components.description: A polar fit field where sectors are categories and distance from the centre is how well each person or bot matches, with a tinted strong-fit zone.

components.title: Prompt Suggestions
components.description: Starter prompt cards for an empty chat and one-line follow-up chips with a refresh button.

components.title: Radar Chart
components.description: A filled polygon over a few axes with a dashed baseline and every member as a dot on each spoke, readable by hover or arrow keys.

components.title: Radial Dots
components.description: A daily or weekly cycle drawn as rings of dots, stacked outward per series, so you see when things happen and not just how many.

components.title: Response Feedback
components.description: Thumbs, copy and regenerate under an answer, with a reasons form or a 1-5 rating card and an undoable send.

components.title: Rolling Number
components.description: An odometer-style number where each digit rolls on its own wheel, rightmost first, with plain, grouped, currency, percent and compact formats.

components.title: Run Trace
components.description: An agent run as a zoomable flame graph of spans, or a breakdown of time, tokens and cost by name.

components.title: Slot Picker
components.description: Meeting-time picker an agent proposes: week or day view, suggested and busy slots, a time-zone switch and a confirm step.

components.title: Tool Approval Queue
components.description: Agent permission requests resolved one by one or in bulk, with payload previews, grant scopes, grouping by risk and an undo log.

components.title: Tool Call Graph
components.description: One agent fanned out to its tools, with edges weighted by call volume, latency or error rate and a flowing hot path.

components.title: Usage Summary
components.description: Daily cost as stacked bars per model with tooltips, a previous-period delta and a budget meter that warns and flips to over.
